fusions.name: All in a Row
fusions.desc: Sends a duckling that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets; the rest of the line follows on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of that.

fusions.name: Calm Imposed
fusions.desc: A sweep across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignores its resistances and leaves it [Damped] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Mantle
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Head
fusions.desc: When an enemy strikes you, a ward absorbs damage equal to 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
